body: The old well’s deep hum resonated through the night, like a whispered secret. With each drip, its rhythmic creaking sent shivers down my spine. Protective warmth surged inside me—a gentle embrace that cradled fear. Yet, beneath this comfort, a darker voice echoed—echoes of what could go wrong if I stepped closer, touched too closely. So, I hesitated, torn between holding onto hope for safety and fleeing into darkness.
